root.label: F1 cars lose power and Malaysia race start is delayed

events.label: F1 cars lose power and Malaysia race start is delayed

slots.name: software updates issued
slots.sentence: After the cars were stuck on track, the start was suspended as the FIA rushed out a software update.

slots.name: start delay duration
slots.sentence: The race eventually started almost an hour later, with no obvious software-related incidents, though the track had dried much more by then.
